candidates.description: The feature represents Hebrew alphabet characters and associated encoding artifacts.
This vector activates on common single-character prefixes, inflectional markers, and subword suffixes across multiple natural languages.
This vector represents proper names and words starting with the letter 'H' or 'A'.
This vector represents the concept of variety, difference, or division across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on Abrahamic religious figures, historical names, and Judeo-Christian terminology starting with the letter J or related roots.
This vector activates for the letter 'n' and variations of the Spanish word 'nos'.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "cre" and related morphological sub-word roots across various contexts.
This feature vector represents adverbial suffixes and related adverbial forms, particularly in Romance languages.
This vector represents common Portuguese grammatical words, pronouns, and prepositions.
This feature vector represents Roman numerals.
